# StreamDek Mobile — 10 August 2026

## New

**Disable a premium service without disconnecting it**
Each debrid provider in Settings → Premium Services now has an on/off switch. Turning
a provider off stops it being used for stream resolution, cached-source markers and
ranking, but keeps the account and its API key in place — so you no longer have to
remove and re-add a service just to test playback without it. Every place that
previously asked "is a debrid account connected?" now asks "is one enabled?", and the
switch applies instantly with a rollback if the server rejects the change.

**VOD badge in the player**
On-demand playlist items played through the live pipeline now show a blue "VOD" badge
with a play icon, instead of the red "LIVE" dot. The distinction is carried on the
session itself, so both the corner badge and the progress area in the control dock
agree about what is actually playing.

## Improved

**Streams tab label no longer hides the count**
On narrow screens the "Streams (25)" pill shared its row with About and up to three
icon buttons and ellipsised to "Streams (2…" — cutting off the one part that mattered.
The label is now measured against the space actually available and falls back to a
compact "⚡ 25" form only when the full wording will not fit. Screen readers still get
the full label either way.

## Fixed

**Titles from AIOMetadata and similar metadata add-ons failed to open**
Two separate id/type mismatches broke the add-on resource chain:

- Catalog items now keep the exact `id` the add-on published (e.g. `tmdb:tv:1399`)
  rather than the numeric `tmdbId` the general TMDB parser preferred. Add-on `/meta`
  and `/stream` routes are keyed by that published id, so the enriched value pointed
  at nothing.
- Metadata requests now use the catalog's own Stremio type. The UI normalises `series`
  to `tv`, but add-ons publish `/meta/series/...` and answer `/meta/tv/...` with an
  empty item; TV cards without a source type fall back to the canonical `series`
  spelling.
